description: gm autosave and GM screen — export the session id so /gm:play and /gm:new-campaign can bind the session to its campaign, then after every turn append the player's prompt and the GM's narration to <campaign>/log/raw/ and checkpoint it. Right after a bind, and on resume and every turn, seal any plaintext an older version left under the bound campaign's .gm/, outside any tool call's diff. Unbound sessions are untouched; every command exits 0 so a hook can never block or fail a turn.

hooks.command: p=$(cat); case "$p" in *bind*) printf '%s' "$p" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/campaign" hook-post-bash 2>/dev/null;; esac; true
